quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 segment drivers (management's analysis): Essential Chemicals Southeast Asia shipments rose on the capacity expansion in Thailand; Automotive sales volume rose in Japan, Europe and North America and the impact of lower vehicle exports to the Middle East stayed minor; Architectural Glass Asia sales rose on higher Southeast Asian shipments despite lower shipments in Japan and lower Southeast Asian prices; Life Science sales rose on more Biopharmaceuticals CDMO orders although synthetic pharmaceutical / agrochemical CDMO orders fell, and its loss narrowed on fixed-cost cuts including the Colorado site closure, more Biopharmaceuticals CDMO orders and better productivity at the Copenhagen site.
R&D: in June 2026 AGC set up a co-creation research laboratory inside Tohoku University to support the cutting-edge electronics industry.
